tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang bstan pa'i gnas tshad de las 'phros pa'i skor 'ga' zhig bcas bshad pa bzhugs

/ ༈ na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ mtshungs med stobs bcu'i rtsal kun rab rdzogs ma 'dres bcwo brgyad g.yu ral gsig /so so yang dag rig pa'i mche gtsigs mi 'jigs rnam bzh-i'i sbar khyim gdengs/ /chos phung brgyad khri'i nga ro cher bsgrags mu stegs glang po'i snying 'gas pa/ /sngon med smra ba'i seṅge'i chen po ston pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ngais pa'i don du spangs rtogs mthar phyin kyang*/ /grangs med zhing du sems dpa'i rnam rol gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bsgrub pa'i 'khur bzhes pa/ /'phags pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la 'dud/ /snying stobs phul byung rgyal dang de yi sras/ /nyan thos tshul gyis thub bstan spel mkhas pa/ /shā ri'i bu sogs nyan thos mchog brgyad dang*/ /gtad rabs bdun sogs nyan rang kun kyang bsngags/ /rgyal bas lung bstan shing rta che gnyis sogs/ /'phags yul mkhas shing grub pa thams cad dang*/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras sogs/ /bod yul bshes gnyen rim par byon la 'dud/ /gang dag rnams mang legs bshad don gnyer zhing*/ /blo gros padmo rgyas 'dod de dag ched/ /sna tshogs gzhung don snying po thor bu 'ga'/ /rang nyid brjod 'dod dbang gis dgod par bya/ /de la 'dir bshad par bya ba la gsum/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis ji ltar mdzad pa/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad/ de las 'phros pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum/ bskal pa'i rnam gzhag /ston pas dang por thugs bskyed cing bar du tshogs bsags tshul/ sangs rgyas nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan tshul lo/ /dang po la gzugs kyi bskal ba'i bar gyi rtsom gzhi ni rdul phra rab bdun la rdul phran gcig de bzhin du lcags rdul/ chu rdul/ ri bong gi rdul/ lug rdul/ glang rdul/ nyi zer rdul/ sro ma dang*/ shig dang*/ sor tshigs rnams snga ma bdun 'gyur la phyi ma re dang*/ sor nyer bzhi la khru gang*/ de bzhi la 'dom gang*/

de lnga brgya la rgyang grags/ de brgyad la dpag tshad gcig 'byung ba yin te/ /mdzod las/ gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul mig dang*/ /skad cig phra rab rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dang ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu ri bong lugs dang glang*/ /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang*/ /de las byung dang de bzhin du/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong 'dun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*/ /de la lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ lo zla zhag gsum sogs dus kyi bskal ba'i rtsom gzhi ni 'chad pa ltar/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ /zhes pa nas/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /zhes pa'i bar gyis rtsom gzhi bshad nas/ bskal ba rnams pa mang bshad pa/ /'jig pa'i bskal ba dmyal ba yi/ /srid pa med nas snod zad pa/ /'chags pa dang po'i rlung nas ni/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /bar gyi bskal pa dpag med nas/ /tshe lo bcu ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas yang skye mar bri ba'i/ /bskal ba gzhan ni bcwo brgyad dang*/ /yar skye ba ni gcig yin te/ /de ltar 'jig rten chags pa 'di/ /bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas/ /chags pa dang ni 'jig pa dang*/ /zhig nas 'dug pa dag mnyam mo/ /de dag brgyad cu la bskal chen/ /zhes pas bskal pa'i rnam gzhag 'chad de/ spyir dag pa'i zhing gi bskal ba dang*/ ma dag pa'i zhing gi bskal ba gnyis yod kyang*/ 'dir ma dag pa'i zhing gi bskal pa'i dbye ba bshad pa gtso che la/ de la 'chags bskal gnas bskal/ 'jig bskal/ zhig nas stong pa'i bskal ba dang*/ gnas bskal ni tshe lo dpag med nas bcu pa'i bar mar 'grib pa'i ma thog gcig dang*/ de nas brgyad khri'i bar yar skye mar 'grib kyi bar khug bcwo brgyad dang*/ de nas mthar brgyad khri'i bar yar 'phel ba'i ya thog gcig ste gnas bskal la bar bskal nyi shu/ 'chags pa la nyi shu/ 'jig pa la nyi shu/

zhig nas stong pa'i bskal ba la bar bskal nyi shu ste de'i bzhi yun tshad mnyam par bshad/ bar bskal nyi shu po tshan pa bzhi la bar gyi bskal ba brgyad bcu 'byung zhing brgyad cu bsdoms pa'i yun la bskal pa chen po gcig go zhes bstan te don bsdus pa'o/ /spyir bskal pa la sgron bskal dang*/ mun bskal gnyis yod pa las/ sangs rgyas dngos su byon nas mdzad pa ston pa la sgron bskal dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa 'byung yang sangs rgyas dngos su mi 'byon pa'i bskal pa la mun bskal zhes brjod do/ /bskal bzang nas da lta'i bskal ba 'di sgron bskal dang*/ de nas mun bskal bskal ba chen po bcu drug de nas sgron bskal bsnyen pa chen po la sangs rgyas khri/ de nas mun bskal khri/ de nas sgron bskal bskal ba skar ma lta bu la sangs rgyas khṛ/ de nas mun bskal sum brgya/ de nas sgron bskal yon tan bkod pa la sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung bar bshad de/ des mtshon pas gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /bskal bzang nas bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang gnyis/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las stong*/ snying rje pad dkar las stong dang lnga'am drug 'byung bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ston pas dang por thugs bskyed tshul ni/ drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo las/ ston pa 'dis sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i tshe grogs la dmigs nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ yang rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po'i drung du thugs bskyed pa'i tshul dang*/ de las gzhan du bshad pa yang yod do/ /tshogs bsags tshul ni/ thun mong ba ltar na/ mdzod las/ rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi tha mar 'byung*/ /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ de grangs med gsum la 'tshang rgya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ston pa 'di gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod du gyur pa'i tshe/

de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po nas sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi bar sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la bsnyen bkur te grangs med dang po'i tshogs bsags/ de rjes tshong dpon shes rab bzang du gyur pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag nas mar me mdzad kyi bar sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs bsags/ gzhon nu chos kyi sprin du gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas rnam gzigs kyi bar bdun khri bdun stong la grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs bsags par bshad cing*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las ni/ theg chen gyi dbang du mdzad de tshogs sbyor gnyis dang sa dang po nas grangs med dang po/ /gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar grangs med gnyis pa/ dag pa sa gsum gyi skabs su grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs bsags zhes gsungs/ theg dman ltar na grangs med gsum gyi tshogs rnams ni tshogs lam gyi skabs kho nar rdzogs par 'dod de/ rgyal po gzhon nu don grub tu gyur te rab tu byung nas rdo rje'i gdan du sbyor lam drod nas mi slob lam gyi bar gdan thog gcig la mngon du byas par 'dod pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar/ /bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun/ /de yi sngon du thar cha mthun/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /theg chen ltar na sngar bshad pa bzhin grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i mthar 'og min du sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog tu sangs rgyas pa'i sprul sku ni lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar du bshad cing*/ kha cig tu longs sku rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtshor sangs rgyas par bshad de tshul gnyis yod la/ grangs med gsum gyi khyad par 'og tu 'chad do/ / gsum pa ni/ lang gshegs las/ rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa yi/ / 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar sngon la 'og min du longs skur sangs rgyas nas de rjes chos sku las ma g.yos par 'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul rim gyis ston pa yin te/

rje btsun byams mgon gyis rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad nas/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis de lta bu'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ni lan gcig tsam ma yin par 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du yang yang ston par bshad do/ /de yang dam pa tog dkar gcig tsam min gyi/ dga' ldan bye ba phrag brgya nas dam pa tog dkar yang de skad cig gis 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba brgyar 'pho ba la sogs pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa yin zhing*/ de la stong gsum gyi rnam gzhag shes dgos te/ stong gsum ni/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi dang ni nyi zla dang*/ /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la de lta bu'i stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya la ni rab 'byams mtshams sbyor/ de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgyud gcig de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams rgyud bar ma/ de phye ba phrag brgya la ni rab 'byams rgya mtsho ste de ni gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i longs sku'i zhing gcig gi bkod pa phal chen las bshad do/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bshad pa la mdor bstan rgyas gnyis las/

dang po ni/ 'pho ba dang*/ lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ bltams pa dang*/ btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang*/ bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ nges par 'byung ba dang*/ dkar ba spyad pa dang*/ byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang*/ bdud sde bcoms pa dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa rnams so/ /gal te byams pa'i gsung las/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /zhes 'byung bas skye ba mngon par skye ba thog mar 'dren rigs so snyam na/ skyon med de/ de bcu gnyis su 'dren pa'i tshul yod kyang skabs 'dir 'dren mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ de ni 'pho ba'i mdzad pa la sogs pa 'byung ba'i gzhi ston pa'i ched du gsungs pa tsam yin gyi/ de 'dren na bcu gnyis las lhag pa'i skyon sogs 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bcu gnyis kyi dang po 'pho ba'i mdzad pa ni/ dam pa tog dkar de nyid kyis dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la chos ston cing bzhugs pa na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi lha'i sil snyan las/ bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mang dran rtogs shing*/ /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dgongs pa mdzod/ /ces bskul ba la brten nas dga' ldan nas yul 'dzam bu'i gling*/ rigs rgyal rigs/ rus bu ram shing ba/ yum sgyu ma lha mdzes/ dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba lnga la gzigs nas 'pho bar dgongs so/ /snyigs ma lnga ni/ dus snyigs ma/ tshe snyigs ma/ lta ba snyigs ma/ nyon mongs snyigs ma/ sems can snyigs ma ste lnga'o/ /de'i tshe lha rnams kyis da lta 'dzam gling na rdzogs byed sogs rtog ge ba drug bram ze rgyu rgyal sogs rjes su sgrogs pa drug /rengs byed kyi bu sogs snyoms par 'jug pa drug gis sems can gyi rgyud ma rung bar byas pas 'pho ba'i dus min no zhes zhus kyang ma gsan par chos bstan te/

mi pham pa'i spyi bor cod pan bcings nas grogs po dgakhyed rnams la mi pham pas chos ston par 'gyur gyi bag yod par spyod cigakho bo ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la bab ste zhes sogs gsungs nas glang po che'i gzugs kyis 'pho bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa lhums su zhugs pa ni/ bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang phug pa yab sras kyis dhru ba yar log sogs kyi sgo nas legs par gtan la phab pa ltar na/ ston pa 'dis sa lug chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcwo lnga la glang chen thal dkar gyi rnam pas yum gyi lhums su zhugs so/ /zhugs ma thag tu yum gy-i dku g.yas su tsandan sprul snying gi khang brtsegs gru bzhi ba rim pa gsum pa yid du 'ong ba'i nang du khri la da lta'i byis pa lo drug lon pa tsam gyi tshad ltar bzhugs nas mthong tshul dang mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bstan to/ /gsum pa sku bltams pa la/ sa skya paṇa chen dang bu ston sogs mkhas pa sngon ma du mas bshad tshul mi mthun pa byung ste/ de yang sa glang*/ shing glang*/ sa 'brug /shing byi/ me yos sogs la sku bltams zhes pa zhed tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ rnam par dag pa ni phug lugs te lhums su zla ba bcu bzhugs nas lcag sprel sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun la skyed mo'i tshal du skar ma rgyal gyi tshe yum gyi rtsib logs g.yas nas bltas bzang po du ma dang bcas nas bltams so/ /de'i tshe bzhugs gnas khang brtsegs gru bzhi pa de tshangs pas lha gnas su 'khyer/ tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin sogs dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nyer dgas khrus gsol/ btsas ma thag tu phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu gom pa bdun bdun bor ba na padma du ma skyes pas/ lum bi'i tshal der padma spungs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs/ btsas pa'i tshe dgos pa'i don mang po byung bas rgyal pos gzhon nu 'di btsas pa na bdag gi don du ma grub pas mtshan gzhon nu don grub tu gsol/

mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'di khyim du gnas na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ btsas nas zhag bdun gyi thog dgos pa'i dbang gi yum 'das nas lhar skyes/ de nas sri mo sgyu 'phrul ma la gtad nas ma ma rnams dang lhan cig bskyangs/ shākya'i rigs rnams kyi nang du thub pa bzhin du gnas pas shākya thub pa zhes bsngags/ gnod sbyin shākya 'phel dang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi sogs lha rnams kyis phyag byas pas lha'i lha zhes mtshan gsol/ / bzhi pa bzo gnas la mkhas pa'i rol rtsed ni/ de nas cung zad nar son pa na yig rigs dang rol rtsed gzhan slob pa'i tshe/ yi ge'i slob dpon gyis yig rigs mi 'dra ba du ma bris te phul ba na de dag rnams nges shes kyi/ padma'i snying po sogs yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi po gang slob ces gsungs pas/ yi ge'i slob dpon gyis de'i ming tsam yang ma shes la/ byang chub sems dpas yi ge de rnams ni 'di dang 'di'o zhes phar bstan pas thams cad ngo mtshar du skyes te skye bo khri phrag smin par byas/ de bzhin du mnga' 'phen pa dang*/ mchong ba dang*/ bang*/ rta rgyug /chu la skyal ba/ glang po che 'dul ba/ stobs brgal ba la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal rnams slob pa'i tshul bstan/ yig rigs rnams dang sgyu rtsal gyi dbye ba 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa btsun mo'i 'khor du bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa ni/ dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshe gzhan dag gis gzhon nu la btsun mo blang bar rigs so zhes gsol ba la brten nas/ shākya lag na be con gyi bu mo grags 'dzin ma dang*/ sa 'tsho ma dang*/ ri dwags skyes ma sogs btsun mo'i tshogs bzhes/ 'ga' zhig tu lag na be con gyi bu mo sa 'tsho mar bshad pa yang snang ste dpyad dgos par 'dug /gzhung che ba du ma nas de'i bu mo grags 'dzin mar bshad cing*/ mda' 'phen sogs sgyu rtsal rnams la 'gran par byas pas gang bzang zhing lhag pa de la rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du de btsun mor ster bar bcas pa na/

de thams cad la gzhon nu ches khyad par du 'phags shing sus kyang 'gran ma nus pas/ gzhon nus thob ste btsun mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du bzhugs nas gzhan mang po smin par mdzad/ gzhon nu rang 'dod chags dang bral yang btsun mo de dag las gang 'dod chags ky-is gdungs pa na/ gzhon nu dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas rang 'dra gnyis pa re sprul te btsun mo de dang de la dga' mgur spyad nas 'dod pa rdzogs par mdzad/ de rnams ni khyim pa'i tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa'o/ /drug pa nges par 'byung ba rab tu byung ba'i mdzad pa ni/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar khab tu bzhugs pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus lha'i sil snyan gyi sgra las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pas rab tu 'byung bar bskul zhing*/ /grong khyer ser skya'i shar sgor rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ lho sgor na ba/ nub sgor 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ byang sgor dge slong dur smrig gyon pa rnams gzigs pas rkyen byas te yab la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pa'i tshe mi gnang bar grong khyer ser skya'i mtha' dmag gis bskor nas bsrungs/ yang yab kyi drung du song nas zhus pas rgyal pos bu 'dir 'dug na bdag cag la phan thogs par 'gyur bas khyed la dgos pa'i dam pa slongs shing ces smras pas/ yab rga nad rgud 'chi las thar pa'i dam pa zhu zhes gsol ba na/ yab kyis de mi nus kyi dam pa gzhan gsol cig /yab 'di nas nying mtshams mi sbyor bar mdzod cig ces zhus pas/ rgyal pos khyed kyi bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig gsungs nas gnang ngo*/ /de nas rab tu 'byung khar grags 'dzin ma'i mngal du sprul pa'i sras kyi sa bon bzhag nas nyer dgu pa sa byi lor nam phyed na rta bsngags ldan la bcibs te/ rmig pa lha'i bus bteg cing lha rnams kyis bskaur nas khyim nas byung ste nam mkhar 'phags shing*/

shar phyogs su dpag tshad bcu gnyis 'das pa yang ba can gyi mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du chibs las babs te rgyan rnams bkrol/ dbu skra dang gtsug phud bcad nas rab tu byung*/ gtsug phud dang gos rgyan brgya byin gyis lha gnas su khyer nas dus ston btsugs/ brgya byin gyis gos ngur smrig phul ba gsol zhing der ngur smrig blangs pa'i mchod rten yang bgyis so/ /bdun pa dka' ba spyad pa'i mdzad pa ni/ chu bo nai rañdza na'i 'gram du 'bru nyag gcig dang chu thig gcig gsol ba dang rkang pa ya gcig gis 'greng ba sogs dka' spyad lo drug tu mdzad cing*/ mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas bsam gtan gyi phar phyin rdzogs pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i dus su byang chub sems dpa'i lus bskams shing shi ba dang 'dra bar rgyal po dang btsun mo'i tshogs rnams kyis mthong nas mya ngan byas pas/ gzhon nu ting nge 'dzin las langs nas mi 'chi bar zhal gyis bzhes te dbugs dbyung*/ grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o mas bsnyen bkur byas pas sku gser gyi mdog lta bur gyur to/ /brgyad pa byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa'i mdzad pa ni/ dgung lo so lnga pa shing rta la babs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje'i gdan du gshegs nas rtswa 'tshong bkra shis la rtsa zor ba bzhes te rdo rje'i gdan gyi byang chub kyi shing gi drung du bting ba de la rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs te/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus ni bskams kyang rung*/ /zhes sogs kyi dam bca' mdzad do/ /dgu pa bdud btul ba'i mdzad pa ni/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams 'bras bu khyad par can mngon du byed pa la bar chad sna tshogs 'byung zhing de dag gis mi tshugs par lam mthar phyin par byed dgos so zhes shes pa dang*/ ye shes kyi nus pa dang stobs kyi che ba ston pa sogs kyi ched du smin mtshams na 'od zer bkye ste/

phyogs kun snang bar byas shing bdud kyi gzhal med khang thams cad mog mog por byas/ bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug gis shes nas rang 'khor dang bcas pa'i dpung gi tshogs thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i drung du lhags te/ ri brag mda' mdung rdo char la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'phangs pa rnams me tog gi char du bsgyur/ yang bdud kyi bu mo gsum gyis g.yo sgyus bslu ba'i thabs byas pa'i tshe de gsum rgan mo'i gzugs su bsgyur/ bdud kyis bsod nams 'di tsam gyis sangs rgyas thob mi nus so zhes smras pa na/ byang chub sems dpas khyod kyis gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig byas pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug thob na/ kho bos de lta bu grangs med byas pas sangs rgyas thob mi dka'o gsungs pa'i tshe/ /bdud kyis nga'i de la khyod dbang po yin na/ khyod kyi de la dbang po gang yod smras pa na/ byang chub sems dpas phyag sa la bzhag ste dpang gsol bas sa'i lha mo brtan mas 'og nas thon te thal mo sbyar nas skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no zhes sogs brjod de dpang por khas blangs/ de nas byang chub sems dpas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba zhes sogs kyis bstod cing 'dud par byas so/ /de rnams ni slob pa'i tshul bstan pa'i mdzad pa'o/ /dgung lo so lnga pa shing rta sa ga'i tshes bcwo lnga'i tho rangs skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe/ zla ba la sgra gcan zhugs pa dang du mtshungs su mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs bar byang chub ste bla na med pa'i ye shes gsar du brnyes pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i tshe grags 'dzin ma las sras bltams shing gnas der mngon par byang chub pa'i mchod rten brtsigs/ 'ga' zhig tu srod lang dud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rangs mngon sangs rgyas zhes 'byung zhing*/

gzhan du bdud 'dul ba'i 'go sngar brtsams nas srod la btul zin pa dang*/ nam srod la bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gung la mngon shes lnga bskyed ces 'byung yang don la thams cad kyang tshul bstan pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas bdun phrag bdun gyi bar chos mi gsung bar btang snyoms su bzhugs shing*/ de yang bdun phrag dang po la byang chub shing drung du bzhugs pa la lha rnams kyis mchod cing bstod/ gnyis pa la stong gsum ring du 'chag /gsum pa la byang chub kyi shing la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ bzhi pa la shar nub kyi rgya mtsho'i bar du 'chag /lnga pa la klu'i rgyal po btang bzung gi gnas su byon/ drug pa la shing na gro dha'i drung du bzhugs/ bdun pa la shing sgrol gyi drung du bzhugs/ de'i mthar tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang skyong la lha'i bkra shis don grub cing zhes sogs bkra shis tshigs bcad gsungs/ rgya cher rol par sangs rgyas nas thog mar/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'di gsungs par bshad/ de ni thun mong ba'i lugs ltar yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs su gnas der rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i rnam par bzhugs te/ kun tu bzang po sogs byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'dus nas sangs rgyas phal po che gsungs par bshad cing*/ sngags kyi skor 'ga' zhig kyang gsungs/ bdun phrag bdun gyi mthar/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas chos mi ston pa ltar bzhugs pa na/ tshangs pa gtsug phud can 'khor dang bcas pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing*/ rgya byin gyis kyang gser gyi maṇḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa phul te bskul ba'i rkyen gyis wa ra ṇa sir byon nas lnga sde dang 'phrad pa na lnga sdes bkur sti mi byed pa'i khrims bcas kyang ston pa'i gzi brjid ma bzod nas bkur sti byas shing de dag la chos bstan/

de nas shing rta'i chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags kyi phyogs gang du chos 'khor bskor bar bzhed pa na der rin po che'i khri bdun stong byung zhing sangs rgyas stong gi khri yang snang ba'i dang po gsum la bskor ba byas/ bzhi pa'i steng du bzhugs nas lnga sde la bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de'i tshe sngon du kau di n+yas dgra bcom thob cing*/ de nas rta thul/ rlangs pa/ ming chen/ bzang ldan bzhis kyang dgra bcom thob/ lha mi khri phrag mang pos bden pa mthong*/ de nas bya rgod phung ri sogs su mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor dang*/ yangs pa can du legs par rnam par 'phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor zhing*/ bar bar du yul gzhan dang phyogs gzhan dag tu byon nas mdo sngags kyi chos gzhan du ma gsungs/ mdor na chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs nas gdul bya rigs can gsum la sogs pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ gzhan yang cho 'phrul chen po'i skor rgyas par ni mdo 'dzangs blun nas 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya zhing*/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus ni dgung lo nga drug pa shing yos zla ba dang po dang*/ lha bab ni dgung lo nga bdun pa me 'brug dbyug zla'i nyer lnga la bstan te bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba'ang yod do/ /bcu gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de ltar sangs rgyas nas lo bzhi bcu rtsa bdun ngo mthong gi bar du chos 'khor bskor nas gya gcig pa lcags 'brug sa ga'i tshes bcwo lnga la gyad yul rtswa mchog grong shing sā la zung gi tshul du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas mya nganalas 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de ni 'khrul med phug pa'i lugs ltar bshad kyi/ gzhan gong du brjod pa ltar 'khrungs pa'i dus la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba 'byung ba ltar gshegs lo yang me rta/ shing sprel/ me phag chu lug me khyi la gshegs pa sogs bzhed pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/

de yang dgung lo brgyad cu'i thog gshegs par bzhed pa mang ngo*/ /de yang sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas rtag 'dzin can rnams mi rtag pa'i chos la bskul ba'i ched gzugs sku'i snang ba gdul bya dman pa'i snang ngor bsdus te mi snang bar bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ don la ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' ba med de/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yong mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can yongs su smin pa'i phyir/ /thabs kyis mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mang ngo*/ /gzhan yang gser 'od las sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston pa la ni dgongs pa rnam pa bcu yod par bshad cing*/ sangs rgyas dang 'phrad dka' zhing dkon par bstan pa dang*/ ring bsrel gyi sgo nas sems can mang po'i don byed par 'gyur ba la'ang dgongs so/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe sprul pa'i ring bsrel shin tu mang po zhig byon cing ring bsrel gyi ched du rtsod pa byung ba na 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i bram ze zhig gis gdung cha brgyad du bgos te/ rtswa can gyi gyad/ sdig pa can gyi gyad/ rgyal rigs bu lug sgra sgrogs rgyal po/ khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze/ shākya'i rigs/ li tsa byi rnams dang*/ ma skyes dgra sogs la so sor byin pas rtsod pa zhi/ de rnam kyis sku gdung gi mchod rten re re brtsigs shing gzhan yang mchod rten brtsigs pa mang du byung ngo*/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i skor rgyas par ni mdo myang 'das dang*/ gzhan mdzad pa'i skor rgyas par ni rgya cher rol ba dang mngon 'byung gi mdo sogs nas shes dgos so/ /de dag ni thun mong du grags pa'i mdzad pa'o/ /gzhan yang*/ thams cad gsang ba'i mdo sgron gsal du drangs pa las/ ston pa sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sprul pa/ yab zas gtsang 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa/ yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo spyan ras gzigs/ btsun mo grags 'dzin ma dpal lha mo/

shā ri'i bu sgrib sel/ kun dga' bo phyag rdor/ lhas sbyin lha'i dbang po'i sprul par bshad de thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs so/ /༈ gnyis pa bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad pa la/ spyi dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas grags med pa yod pas bstan pa'i gnas tshad 'dzin dka' yang*/ 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyi dbang du byas nas lung phran tshegs las bstan pa lo stong du gnas pa dang blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba dag gis 'bras bu thob pa dang shin tu rgyas pa'i dus su ni lo stong zhig 'dzam bu'i gling du gnas so zhes dang*/ rgyal po kri kri rmi lam lung bstan pa las sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa lo stong gnas zhes gsungs shing*/ mdzod rang 'grel las kyang*/ de dag kyang lo stong du gnas so zhes dang*/ snying rje pad dkar gyi bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi smon lam skabs nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong du dam pa'i chos gnas par gyur cig lo lnga brgyar dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan gnas par gyur cig ces 'byung zhing*/ zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan lo nyis stong du gnas par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ ka ma la shī la'i rdor gcod kyi 'grel par lnga brgya tha ma la zhes bya ba la/ brgya phrag lnga'i tshogs lnga brgya ste bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa lnga brgya phrag lnga'i bar du gnas zhes grags zhes dang*/ bskal bzang las/ dam pa'i chos lo lnga brgya'i bar du gnas so/ /lo lnga brgya'i bar du ni dam pa'i chos ltar snang ngo zhes dang*/ daṃṣta se nā'i 'bum ṭīka tu/ phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya'i tha ma zhes pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa lo lnga stong du gnas pa las stong phrag re re phyed phyed du bcad pas lnga brgya phrag bcu zhes dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad par grags pa'i yum gsum gyi 'grel pa las/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa gnas pa ni lo lnga stong du gsungs te zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas kyang lnga stong du bshad/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel gzhan 'ga' zhig las kyang 'dra mi 'dra ci rigs bshad cing*/ de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa chen po 'gas kyang bshad tshul mi 'dra la/ 'on kyang sngon gyi mkhas pa phal cher bstan pa lo lnga brgya dang*/ stong pa sogs par gsungs pa drang don dgongs pa can dang*/ yang dag pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad ni lnga stong du zhal mthun par bzhed/ da ltar mi mthun pa byung yang dgongs pa mi 'gal te/ lnga brgya dang stong du gnas par bshad pa ni grol ba thob pa shas che ba'i dbang du mdzad/ nyis stong sogs ni 'bras bu la zhugs pa dang sgrub pa dang lung la slob pa'i dbang du mdzad/ lnga stong ni phal cher lta ba dang sgrub pa phyogs mthun pa'i dbang du mdzad ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /mkhas pa la la ni/ lnga brgya dang stong ni rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnas pa dang nyis stong dang lnga stong ni lung gi bstan pa'i dbang du byas so zhes bzhed la/ dus 'khor lugs kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad ni lnga stong chig brgya dang bzhir bshad do/ /ston pa lcags 'brug la 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa nas bzung ste/ 'bum ṭīka ltar lnga brgya ba phrag bcu'i dang po 'bras bu'i dus la ni/ dgra bcom/ phyir mi 'ong*/ rgyun zhugs gsum/ sgrub pa'i dus la ni/ shes rab/ ting nge 'dzin/ tshul khrims kyis bslab pa gsum/ lung gi dus la ni/ mngon pa/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba gsum 'byung zhing*/ lhag ma lnga brgya pa gcig la ni/ lta spyod rnal ma med par rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'byung*/ kha cig lung dang sgrub pa'i dus gnyis snga ma las ldog ste bshad pa yang mchis so/ /'o na/ ston pa 'das nas da lta'i bar lo ci tsam song snyam na/ 'di la yang bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du snang yang*/ 'khrul med phug pa'i lugs la da lta'i rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing bya'i 'di'i bar la lo nyis stong drug brgya dang nyer lnga song ngo*/

/gsum pa de dag las 'phros pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa la bzhi/ grangs med kyi brtsi gzhi dang lo zla zhag gsum gyi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad pa/ grangs med gsum gyi rnam gzhag /grangs kyi rnam gzhag /ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdzod las skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ /de yi skad cig de dag kyang*/ /drug cu la ni thang gcig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /ces 'byung ba ltar/ dus kyi rtsom gzhi ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma gcig /de'i skad cig ma drug cu la thang gcig /de sum cu la yud tsam gcig /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba gcig /de bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu bshad la/ dus 'khor las ni/ mi dkyus ma'i dbugs 'byung 'jug gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i yun la dbugs gcig /de drug la chu srang gcig /de drug cu la chu tshod gcig /de drug cur nyin zhag gcig gi tshad bshad de/ don la ni zhag sngon ma'i nyi ma shar ba nas sang nyi ma 'char kha'i bar ro/ /tshes zhag ni zla ba'i dkar nag gi 'phel 'grib kyi cha bcwo lnga la bzhag pa'i char ste/ de re la chu tshod nga dgu /chu srang gsum/ dbugs lnga/ ri mkha' ri'i cha bcu drug dang*/ khyim zhag ni nyi mas skar khyim bgrod pa'i khyim rer khyim zla re dang khyim zla rer khyim zhag sum cu/ khyim zhag re la chu tshod drug cu/ chu srang nga gnyis/ dbugs bzhi/ ri mkha' ri'i cha brgya re brgya/ mda' ro'i cha bcu re yod/ khyim zla drug la bgrod pa re/ bgrod pa gnyis la lo re'o/ /dngos btags ma phye bar brjod na lo tshes so/ /nyin zhag gi lo/ /khyim lo gsum dang*/ zla ba la'ang tshes zla/ nyin zla/ khyim zla gsum dang*/ zhag la'ang de bzhin du sbyor/ /de la zla bshol ma byung bar du tshes lo gtso che la/

zla bshol 'don pa ni khyim lo'i dbang du btang ba yin te/ bgrod gnyis mthar thug pa ni khyim lo ma gtogs/ gzhan gnyis la mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /da lta'i brtsi tshul ltar na ni zhag la nyin zhagazla ba la tshes zla/ lo la khy-im lo gtso che ba yin no/ /gnyis pa grangs med gsum gyi brtsi tshul ni/ gong du grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags zhes bshad na/ de gsum gyi 'jog tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni mdzod 'grel las rkyang khug gnyis bshad pa'i dang po ni/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang*/ /sa ya bye ba dung 'phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa khug pa ni/ ther 'bum 1khrag khrig 2rab bkram 3dang*/ gtam 4dkrigs 5mi 'khrugs 6khyad 'byin 7dang*/ spang rten 8der 'dren 9mtha' snang 10dang*/ /rgyu rigs 11'od mdzes 12dbang po 13dang*/ /legs 'byin 14rtogs 'gro 15'bying rngub 16dang*/ brgya rtags 17stobs 'khor 18brda shes 19dang*/ rnam byung 20stobs mig 21zhes 'byung ba ltar rkyang pa gcig nas dung 'phyur bar gnas dgu dang*/ khug pa ther 'bum nas stobs mig par gnas nyer gcig ste de yang dung 'phyur bcu la ther 'bum gcig /ther 'bum bcu la ther 'bum chen po gcig /de bcu la khrag khrig gcig /de bcu la khrag khrig chen po gcigade bcu la rab bkram gcig /de bcu la rab bkram chen po gcig sogs stobs mig gi bar chen po dang bcas bcu gyur byas pa'i khug pa grangs gnas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du rkyang ba'i dgu bsnan bas nga gcig go /gnas drug cu'i dbang du byas na snga ma'i steng du byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms te tshad med bzhi'i ming can sngar ltar chen po dang bcas na nga dgu dang*/ drug cu pa ni de lta bu'i grangs las 'das pas grangs med ces bya'o/ /de yang bcu 'gyur du byas pas grangs med gsum zhes bshad/ khug pa'i skabs su rnam grangs mi mthun pa yod de/

gtam dkrigs gcig tu byas pa dang so sor byas pa gnyis dang*/ stobs mig gi mjug tu khyad 'byin yod med gnyis byung yang rang lugs ni gong bzhin no/ /grangs med kyi bar mchongs te brtsi na myur yang*/ re re nas ming gis brjod cing brtsi na shin tu 'gor te/ dper na ma ṇi dung 'phyur gcig ni mi gcig gis nan tan byas kyang lo bcu skor zhig 'gro dgos par mngon pas/ de ltar na grangs med par re re bzhin brtsi na ni lo lnga bcus kyang mi rdzogs par gsal lo/ /gsum pa grangs kyi gnas gzhan ni bshad tshul mi 'dra ba la/ 'phags yul du dmangs kyis brjod pa ni/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang*/ /sa ya bye ma dung 'phyur dang*/ /ther 'bum shu rdo mchog nyal dang*/ /skya 'phyis bye ma nab nub dang*/ mtsho yas ldabs phyor rdzi zhes gnas/ /gong nas gong du bcu 'gyur bsgre/ /zhes pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i grangs gnas yin par bshad cing*/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ bye ba khod khod thad dgu dang*/ khrig khrig thams thams myang myid dang*/ gang ya ban bun phyar phyur dang*/ /lcag lcig byang bying chem chem dang*/ /phyal phyal khyad khyung zar zer dang*/ /khrib khrib ya gangs cho ma dang*/ /khrim khrim nab nub sang sad dang*/ /brgyud yas btang yas bkra yar dang*/ /gsa' yas mtshungs med la lum dang*/ /yal yol khral khrul thud thud dang*/ /bsam byed brang bred sgrod yas dang*/ /sngo yas zang yag 'phro skye dang*/ /rtsa 'phyo yongs bstan shug yos dang*/ /sang thal thid yug yid 'phyo dang*/ /nab nab khrig tham yal yal dang*/ /bgrangs yas thum yas shang shang dang*/ /yag yag thim thim slom nyal dang*/ /gzhal 'phyos gzhal yal gzhal yad dang*/ /gzhal 'khor gzhal thim ga gzhal dang*/ /gzhal sangs gzhal thag gzhal phul dang*/ /gzhal gzhi 'phyong 'gyur nya nyer dang*/ /phyag phyig zal zug sal sal dang*/ /g.yo ldeg phan phun gdang yas dang*/ /rim gro rjing rjing sdug bsngal dang*/

/phun yol ngad ngad bgrang rtsi dang*/ /zab bgrang dga' rkyang gzhung 'dal dang*/ /khug phyang 'ol phyong gdab yas dang*/ /gcam yas bgrang yas kyi 'phyo dang*/ /ya mad skal yas 'dab 'deb dang*/ /'phan bcad 'phang phung be'u tshang dang*/ /zhun bzung mchog yal mtha' brdul dang*/ /yung 'gyangs bun lob lam lom dang*/ /brnan yas lang ling ljib ljib dang*/ /mi bcam 'jam yas nga sbrang dang*/ /smos yal bkra tshal lo rgyas dang*/ /'bum tig gam gum la lo dang*/ /bgrang 'phyos bgrang 'phyos la bsgres pa/ /dpag yas de bsgres yal 'phyong dang*/ /de rjes mu yal mu yal bsgres/ /bgrang yol gnyis dang mi 'jal gnyis/ /bsam phyod gnyis dang mtha' 'byams gnyis/ /dpag thag gnyis dang brjod med gnyis/ /brjod med pa'i yang brjod med la/ /sgres la shin tu brtan pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i grangs gnas la brgya dang nyer brgyad 'byung*/ brtsi tshul ni/ brgya brgya la stong*/ stong stong la bye ba/ bye ba bye ba la khod khod/ khod khod la thad dgu /thad dgu thad dgu la khrig khrig sogs rigs bgres te brtsi ba'o/ /'di dag ni grangs med dang brjod du med pa las kyang 'das pa'i brtsi tshul te mtha' ni so skye'i yul las 'das pa'o/ /yang rgya cher rol pa las/ bye ba ther 'bum khrag khrig dang*/ /gtam dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang*/ /spang rten mang 'dzin glang po'i stobs/ /dogs thob rnam gzhag gdags rgyu rig /lag sbyin rgyud pad rdzogs thob dang*/ /bgrang rtogs sgrib ba stobs kun stobs/ /rnam brda shes ldan brda shes kun/ /rnam 'byung de yi mtshan nyid can/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu dang*/ /ded 'dren zhes gdags gtan la 'bebs/ /gcod rtogs gcod rtogs ldan dag ni/ /thams cad rnam 'byed snying po mchog /phra rab rdul gyi rjes su 'jug /zhes sogs grangs gnas sogs gnyis gong nas gong du brgya 'gyur bsgre bar gsungs te/ de yang bye ba brgya la ther 'bum gcig

/de brgya la khrag khrig gcig sogs sbyar ba'o/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni/ brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya bye/ /dung 'phyur ther 'bum ther 'bum che/ /shu rdog mchog nyal rkyang phye dang*/ /rkyang phye che dang khyad 'byin gnyis/ /rgyu ba gnyis dang mtsho yas gnyis/ /dug can rgya mtsho che dang bcas/ /mchog yas ban bun ma lus pa/ /ma lus che dang grangs med dang*/ dpag med gnyis dang 'jig rten gnyis/ /mun pa snang ba snang ba che/ /phung po gnyis dang zab pa dang*/ brtan pa rab brtan 'gro mang ldan/ /gnas dang gnas chen dpag med gnyis/ /don chen rgya mtsho mchog gtso khyim/ /bsam mi khyab dang mi zad gzugs/ /rgyal thabs gter dang dge ba dang*/ /sems byung gnyis dang brjod pa dang*/ /brjod brnyan yas bsnyad yas che dang*/ /phyar phyur gnyis dang shu rdog dang*/ /shu 'og che dang zhi ba dang*/ /chu 'byung stes 'khrul dam pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas yul dang 'phel byed dang*/ /de ltar grangs gnas drug cu dgu/ /gong nas gong du bcu 'gyur yin/ /de yan sangs rgyas nyid kyi yul/ /de phyir 'gro bas bgrang mi nus/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las gsungs ba'i grangs gnas gzhan yang yod do/ /'on kyang thams cad la grags che ba ni mdzod 'grel nas bshad pa de'o/ /bzhi pa ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pas/ /don gyi ngo bo brjod pa ming*/ /de yi khyad par brjod pa tshig /gang yang mi ston yi ge'o/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ lha/ klu/ mi/ bum pa/ ka ba zhes pa lta bu don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa ni ming*/ lha yod/ klu 'byung*/ mi srid/ ka ba mi rtag /bum pa byas sogs lta bu don gyi khyad par brjod pa tshig go /ka ba mi rtag zhes pa lta bu don gyi khyad par brjod pa yin kyang*/ ka ba dang mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa lta bu dang mi 'dra ste/ snga ma ni mi rtag pa ka ba dang 'brel bar brjod cing*/

/phyi ma mi rtag pa dang ka ba gnyis ma 'brel bar so sor brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags yul gyi yi ge a ā sogs dbyangs dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga sogs gsal byed rnams dang*/ bod kyi dbyangs a i u o bzhi dang*/ ka kha ga nga sogs gsal byed rnams ni brjod bya gang yang mi ston pa'i yi ge tsam mo/ /yi ge'i gzugs la kha'i yi ge gcig yin kyang*/ brjod byed la mi'i kha zhes brjaud pa lta bu ni yi ge gnyis 'dus pa yin te/ kha ni rang gi srog tu zhugs pa'i a dang dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du nga dang ja dang nya dang na dang pha dang ma dang tsha dang wa dang zha dang za dang ra dang sha dang sa rnams la yang de lta bu'i khyad par yod de shes dgos so/ /mig ces pa lta bu la yi ge gsum 'dus te/ ma dang ga dang srog gi i gsum 'dus pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin du yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i ming mang ngo*/ /ming la dbye na thog mar brda sbyar ba'i 'dod rgyal dang*/ /phyis sbyar ba'i rjes grub gnyis sam/ dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan nam sgra bshad la ma bltos par thog mar brda sbyar ba'i ming ste/ 'byung ba rnams la sa chu me rlung zhes dang*/ lha mi sogs dang ka bum sogs su btags pa lta bu dang*/ der ma zad sems can zhig skyes pa na rgyu mtshan sogs la bltos pa med par bkra shis dang bsod nams dang tshe ring sogs su btags pa lta bu'o/ /btags ming ni 'dra 'brel lta bu'i sgo nas ming gzhan du btags pa ste/ 'dra ba'i sgo nas btags pa ni/ bram ze'i khye'u kha che sna nyag pa la seṅge zhes btags pa ste/ rnam 'grel las/ seṅge bram ze'i khye'u la/ /de ltar brjod pa 'jig rten yod/ /ces so/ /'brel ba'i sgo nas btags pa ni/ ras yug gi zur tshig pa la ras yug tshig ces brjod pa lta bu'o/ /dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis so so la'ang sgra bshad yod med gnyis yod cing*/ btags ming la don mthun dang don mi mthun gnyis/

yang brten pa'i ming rten la btags pa/ rgyu ming 'bras la btags pa 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa sogs mang zhing*/ brten pa'i ming rten la btags pa ni/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la nyi ma dang zla ba zhes pa lta bu dang*/ rgyu ming 'bras la btags pa ni da lta bde sdug myong ba la sngon gyi las zhes pa lta bu dang*/ rlung nad/ mkhris nad ces pa lta bu dang*/ 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa ni/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas zhes btags pa dang*/ bur shun gyi ro lta bu'i sems la byang chub kyi sems zhes btags pa dang*/ gro nas sogs kyi myu gu sngon po la gro nas sogs su brjaud pa lta bu dang*/ spyi ming bye brag la btags pa ni rgyu nor la dngos po zhes brjod pa lta bu dang*/ bye brag gi ming spyi la btags pa ni yul gzhan na rab byung kun la bla ma zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /btags ming tshad ldan la der 'dod pa'i chos gsum tshang dgos te/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa med par 'dogs na kun la kun 'dogs thal ba dang*/ 'dogs pa po dpyod ldan ma yin pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ gal te 'dir ni btags 'dod na/ rgyu tshan gang gis de 'dogs pa/ /de bzhin dngos po thams cad la/ /de dag gis rgyur cis mi 'dogs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos la gnod byed yod dgos te/ med na btags ming du mi 'thad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tshig bshad la'ang gsung rab spyi la grags pa ni/ dpang lau chen pos/ ming gnyis sam ni mang po yis/ /don gyi khyad par brjod byed pa/ /dam chos mngon par gsungs pa yi/ /tshig yin yi ge 'dus pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /'dus byas mi rtag lta bu ming gnyis 'dus pa dang*/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal zhes dang/ chos thams cad bdag med do zhes pa lta bu ming du ma 'dus pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi gzhung che ba'i tshig 'phreng lta bu'o/ /sgra'i bstan bcos las ni su pa dang ting gi mtha' can tshig

/ces bshad pa ltar su pa dang ting gi mtha' can dang*/ si sogs rnam dbye'i mtha' can dang*/ ti sogs kyi mtha' can gyi tshig la tshig ces bshad de snga ma dang mi 'dra'o/ /yi ge dngos ni skad kyi gdangs la byed cing rang rgyu kun slong gi shes pa las skyes pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ /skye la shes par sgra skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yun tshad kyang*/ yi ge'i bdag nyid kun mtha' yang*/ /mig 'dzum tshad du gnas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ming tshig yi ge gsum ni 'dus byas su nang sde kun 'dod cing sgra'i rang bzhin te/ gang zag mchog dman kun la yod do/ /mkhas pa kha cig mdo sde pa dang bye brag tu smra bas ldan min dang*/ sems tsam pas rnam rig tu 'dod ces gsungs/ des na bris pa'i yi ge'i gzugs rnams ni yi ge dngos min zhing der btags pa tsam te/ bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs bzhin no/ /yi ge'i gzugs la ni spyir 'jig rten thams cad na yod pa'i tshad dka' yang yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ de la yang mi mthun pa re gnyis yod kyang dag pa'i lugs gcig la ni/ tshangs pa'i yi ge de bzhin du sbyar te/ kha roṣṇī/ padma'i snying po/ aṅgi'i/ baṅga'i/ ma ga ngha/ bkra shis pa/ sor mo/ shā ka na/ pā dha ni/ a hu ba/ rtsub mo/ 'gro lding*/ mon yul/ lho phyogs/ drag po/ grangs/ spyi'u tshugs/ rjes su mthun pa/ dha ri ḍa/ khyā sya/ rgya nagahu na/ dbus/ rgyal/ lha/ klu/ gnod byin/ dri za/ mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding*/ ri dwags kyi 'khor lo/ bya rog skad/ sa lha/ bar snang gi lha/ ba lang spyod/ sgra mi snyan/ lus 'phags po/ 'degs pa/ bzhag pa/ rab tu bzhag pa/ rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ rdo rje'i/ 'phrin/ rab tu 'phrin/ rnam gzhag /chung ngu yin/ bstan bcos skor/ rtsis skor/ 'degs skor/ rkang pas bris pa/ tshig phyi ma grub pa/ ji srid tshig phyi ma grub pa/

bar sgrub pa/ sgra thams cad kun bsdus/ rigs dang rjes su 'thun pa/ rnam par bsres pa/ drang srong dka' thub kyis gdungs pa/ gsal ba/ rab tu gsal ba/ sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa/ snying po kun bsdus kyi yi ge ste drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de dag phal cher ni bod du ma byung la/ bod du yod pa ni/ tshangs pa'i yi ge lañtsa/ de la yang khong seng dang sha chen gnyis/ de dang mthun par dha ri'i ka'i yi ge rigs lnga/ de'i mgo gyen bzed de nā ga ra'i yig rigs drug /mgo thur bkug klu'i yi ge wattu la/ kasmī ra mi 'dra ba gsum sogs kyang yod par bshad/ de dag ni gzhon nu don grub kyis yig rigs slob pa las 'phros te bshad pa yin la/ gzhan yang mdzad bcu las/ drug cu rtsa bzhi las brgal sgyu rtsal gyis/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar sgyu rtsal drug cu re bzhi sogs ni/ rgya cher rol ba las/ mchod pa/ yi ge lag rtsis/ rtsis/ grangs/ gyad kyi 'dzin stang*/ rgyang nas 'phog pa/ bang*/ tshar/ rkyal/ 'phongs dpyad/ glang chen gyi gnyar spyon pa/ rta rtsal/ shing rta'i thabs/ mda' gzhu'i thabs/ brtanapa/ mthu/ dpa' ba/ 'gyad stabs/ lcags kyus bsgyur thabs/ zhags thabs/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/ gzung ba/ 'dzin stangs/ thor tshugs/ bcad pa/ ngal ba/ dbug pa/ gzhig pa/ gshag pa/ mi tshor bar 'phog ba/ gnad du 'phog pa/ sgra drag par 'phog pa/ tshabs che ba/ cho lo'i rtsed mo/ snyan ngag sbyar ba/ lam/ ris/ gzugs/ gzugs kyi las/ thags kyi dpyad/ me'i las/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs/ gar/ glu/ yi ge bklag pa'i mig 'or/ gtam/ gzhad gad/ rtsed mo/ bro/ sgeg pa/ 'phreng brgyu ba/ rlung yob g.yob pa/ nor gru mtshon bsgyur/ gos mtshon gyis bsgyur ba/ mig 'khrul gyi cho ga /rmi lam gyi dpyad/ byi'u'i skad/ bud med kyi mtshan/ skyes pa'i mtshan/ de bzhin du glang po dang*/ rta/ ba lang*/ ra/ lug khyi'i mtshan dang*/ shes gsal/ sgra nges par sbyor ba/ nga ro bsgyur pa/

sngon rabs/ sngon byung*/ reg byed/ lung bstan pa/ nges pa'i tshig /yi ge lī yang*/ tshig sdeb/ mchod sbyin cho ga /skar ma/ grangs can/ rnal 'byor gyi lugs gsum dang*/ las kyi tshogs dang bye brag pa'i lugs/ nor gyi rig pa/ phur bu/ chu/ lha min gyi lugs gsum dang*/ bya dang*/ ri dwags kyi skad/ gtan tshig rig /rgya skyegs kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sgra tshil gyi las/ 'drub shur/ brko gzhag /lo ma dro ba/ spos sbyor sogs mang yang bsdu na drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad/ gzhan yang*/ slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis phran tshegs 'grel bar snga ma dang mi 'dra bar sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi bshad la/ gzhung gzhan du nang gi sgyu rtsal re bzhi yang bshad do/ /so dang sen mo 'debs dang 'khyud/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar ro/ /bye brag rtog byed las ni/ bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu dang*/ rol mo'i bye brag bcwo brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/ gang gyi cha byad dgu bshad pa'i dang po sum cu ni/ yi ge /yag rtsis/ grangs/ rtsas chen/ gom snyabs/ thor tshugs/ lcags kyus bsgyur thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen pa/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/ bcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas 'phog pa/ sgra drag par 'phog pa/ gnad du 'phog pa/ mi tshor bar 'phog pa/ tshabs che bar 'phog pa/ mchod pa/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/ bang*/ kyal*/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa/ rta zhon pa/ shing rta'i thabs/ mda'/ gzhu/ gyad stobs rnams so/ /gnyis pa bcwo brgyad ni/ gar mkhan/ bro/ rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga phran/ rnga chen po/ 'khar ba/ pi wang rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar ba'i sil khrol/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ rnga ma kunda/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa/ pheb rdob/ rol mo/ sgra rigs/ pi wang gzhan/ gling bu rnams so/ /gsum pa bdun ni/ bar ma/ drang srong*/ sa 'dzin/ drug ldan/ lnga pa/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan rnams so/

/bzhi pa dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/ bzhad pa/ 'jigs rung*/ snying rje/ zhi ba rnams so/ /gzhan yang bzo sbyangs bcwo brgyad bshad de/ tshor ba dang*/ rdza mkhan/ 'phreng mkhan/ chang 'tshong/ phyugs 'tshong*/ 'dreg mkhan/ 'bru mar btsir ba/ mgar ba/ shing mkhan/ phywa mkhan/ thag pa/ rkyal chen pa/ ko pags mkhan/ btso lag mkhan/ smyig ma mkhan/ bshan pa/ gdol ba mkhan/ shing rta mkhan rnams so/ /brtag pa rnam pa brgyad bshad de/ rin po che brtag pa/ sa gzhi brtag pa/ gos brtag pa/ ljon shing brtag pa/ rta brtag pa/ glang po che brtag pa*/ skyes pa brtag pa/ bud med brtag pa rnams so/ /yang shes bya rig gnas che ba lnga ni/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshig rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ nang don rig pa ste lnga/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ snyan ngag /sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlo gar/ rtsis rnams so/ /rig gnas che ba'i sgra rig pa la/ 'phags yul du sgra mdo chen po brgyad byung zhing*/ bod du pā ṇi/ dbyangs can sgra mdo/ tsand+ra pa/ kā la pa rnams 'gyur ro/ /'phags yul du sgra rig la mkhas pa shin tu mang bar byon la/ bod du ni sngon sgra rig la mkhas pa'i lotstsha ba mang du byung yang phyis dkon pa ltar snang la/ mdo smad kyi phyogs 'dir ni de lta bu srid mtha' tsam ste/ 'on kyang mtshams sbyor lnga pa dang sngags klog la sbyangs pa 'ga' re snang ngo*/ /bod skad kyi dbang du byas pa'i sgra rig pa ni sum rtags dang dag yig gi skor yin pas sgra rig pa'i phyogs mi shes pa yang min no/ /gtan tshig rig pa ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang gzhan las kyang 'byung mod/ gtso bo ni phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun btus dang*/ chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ de dag las 'phros pa'i bsdus gzhung rnams so/ /bzo rig la lus bzo shing bzo/ lcags bzo/ gos bzo/ lha bzo/ yig bzo sogs mang zhing ngag bzo dang yid bzo yang bshad/

gso ba rig pa ni sman sbyor shes pa ste sman gyi gzhung mang ngo*/ /nang don rig pa ston pa'i gzhung ni sde snod gsum sogs mngon mtho nges legs ston pa'i mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams te/ rig gnas sngon ma bzhi las khyad par du 'phags so/ /gtan tshig rig pa dang nang rig pa ston pa'i gzhung mi 'gal te/ rnam 'grel lta bus gtan tshig rig pa dang nang don rig pa gnyis ka ston pa'i phyir te/ des thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa dngos stobs kyi rigs pas sgrub cing nyams len dang 'brel bar 'chad pa'i phyir ro/ /snyan ngag la ni don rgyan dang sgra rgyan gnyis yod cing grags che la/ sdeb sbyor dngos ni sgra rig pa'i yan lag yin pas bod skad la ji bzhin med kyang phyogs mthun tshig gi sbyor ba ni bod skad la yang yod de/ dag yig gi rnam dbye sogs dang snyan ngag sbyor lugs legs po shes na ni tshig gi sdeb sbyor byed shes pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon brjod ni nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu sogs la ming sna tshogs kyis brjod pa ste/ nyi ma la tsha zer can dang 'od stong can sogs su brjod pa lta bu'o/ /zlos gar la ni lus kyis gar byed cing ngag gis glu len pa sogs lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur mang po zhig bshad/ rtsis la skar rtsis nag rtsis gnyis las/ skar rtsis ni dus 'khor gyi lugs te shambha la dang 'phags yul nas bod du dar la/ nag rtsis ni rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rgya nag tu gsungs shing bod dang rgya nag gi phyogs rnams su dar che/ de yang skar ma'i rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pas skar rtsis dang*/ sa bdag gi rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa'i phyir nag rtsis zhes bya'i/ dkar nag tsam gyi don min no/ /skar rtsis la ni/ lo dang zla ba dag pa/ gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa ste yan lag lnga dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ gza' 'dzin skor dang*/ dus sbyor dang*/ gza' lnga dang*/ zhag gsum rnam dbye dang*/

stong 'jug gi skor sogs mang zhing*/ nag rtsis la ni/ spar kha/ sme ba/ lo 'gros bcu gnyis dang drug cu'i skor/ gza' skar dang*/ tshe rabs las rtsis/ bag rtsis/ skeg rtsis skor du ma dang*/ gshin rtsis dang*/ sa bdag gi skor dang*/ de dag bco thabs sogs mang ngo*/ /gza' skar gyi rnam gzhag ni mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po dang tog gzungs la sogs pa'i mdo phyogs dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud gzhan dag dang*/ dus 'khor gyi skor nas bshad pas shes dgos so/ /smras pa/ lha mi'i ston pa zas gtsang sras po des/ bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i rnam rol bstan pa las/ cha tsam ston pa'i bka' drin dran phyir bshad/ /de las 'phros pa'i rnam gzhag 'di dag kyang*/ /dad ldan rnam dpyod don gnyer can 'ga' zhig /rab 'byams shes bya'i rnam grangs du ma la/ /blo gros 'jug pa rgyas pa'i ched du bkod/ /'di rnams 'di ltar bshad pa'i rab dkar dges/ /ma sogs ma lus 'gro ba thams cad kyang*/ /skye dang skye bar bde ldan mngon dga' sogs/ /zhing nas zhing brgyud sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /khyad par thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbus skyes pa'i/ /gzhung lugs mang thos gdengs can dbang bo bos/ /lha mi'i rten gyi bdud rtsi rtag 'thung zhing*/ /rnam grol nor bu'i gtsug rgyan myur bsten shog /ces ston pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi skor la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang lo bdun cu'i thog dad pas kun nas bslangs te co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ/ /
